# DAViewer v0.5.19

## 本次更新

- 修复视频暂停后仍然自动继续播放的问题，现在只有点击播放按钮才会恢复播放。
- 修复从详情页返回或应用切回前台时，被手动暂停的视频会自行恢复播放的问题。
- 修复作品详情页的作者描述、简短介绍和附言大量消失的问题。
- 描述加载失败时改为明确提示并提供重试，不再直接显示为空白。

## What's New

- Fix videos resuming on their own after being paused; only the play button resumes playback now.
- Fix paused videos resuming when leaving the detail page or returning to the app.
- Restore artwork descriptions, short introductions and notes that had disappeared from the detail page.
- Show a clear message with retry when a description fails to load, instead of silently showing nothing.
